parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism table. Join compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id to get substrate compound name. Join compound_records again on metabolism.drug_record_id to get parent compound name. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent compound molregno to get active molregno. Join compound_structures on active molregno to get canonical_smiles. Filter organism equals Callithrix jacchus. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Limit 200.
